testimonials.quote: We've booked our second cruise, our first with Charlie at Cruise Aboard. So very pleased he made it really easy and did all the leg work! He provided multiple quotes before we found the right cruise for us, which was made up of two families and three cabins! Plus they are much cheaper than going directly to MSC... we've saved hundreds of pounds! Fantastic communication as well. Charlie liaised with both myself and my father-in-law to get this holiday right for us.
testimonials.name: Catherine Bissell

testimonials.quote: Just booked a dream cruise with Charlie in a few hours. It has previously taken me a couple of days through the cruise company. Charlie answered all my queries quickly and thoroughly and even advised me about the extras. Would thoroughly recommend his service and will go back to him in the future.
testimonials.name: Jan Moore

testimonials.quote: Cruise Aboard makes booking a cruise so very easy. Charlie pays attention to the detail that is important to the individual customer. Charlie's wealth of experience makes him a cruise expert, which is especially invaluable to any first time cruiser. Charlie is always on hand if you have any questions after you've booked too!
testimonials.name: Rose Hall

testimonials.quote: We have just booked our next cruise via Charlie and he has been fantastic! He was super patient with our questions and supported in getting some missing Voyager points added to our MSC account. Nothing was too much trouble and his responses were so quick! Highly recommend and will definitely be using Charlie for our cruise bookings in the future.
testimonials.name: Sally CK

testimonials.quote: Went on a one night taster cruising, loved it so much I want to go on a slightly longer one. Charlie was amazing, very concise, extremely helpful and knowledgeable with what you see is what you pay prices, no unexpected add ons. He took all the hard work out of researching and booking!
testimonials.name: Debra Cooper

testimonials.quote: Charlie was so responsive, informative and helpful. Great customer service and I was pleased to get a good price. Would recommend and will hopefully book again. Thanks!
testimonials.name: Jos Bamford
